title.en: How to draw the best line, and how good it is
title.zh: 怎样画出最佳直线，以及它有多好

description.en: Drag a line through a cloud of points and watch the squared errors. The best line is the one with the smallest total, r² says how much better it is than a flat line at the mean, and the exam’s kangaroo question puts the whole method on one page.
description.zh: 在一团点里拖一条直线，看误差的平方。最佳直线是总和最小的那条，r² 说明它比水平的均值线好多少，而考试里的袋鼠题把整套方法放在一页纸上。

name.en: Simple linear regression by least squares
name.zh: 一元线性回归（最小二乘）

description.en: Reading r² as the percentage of predictions that are correct
description.zh: 把 r² 当作预测正确的百分比

description.en: Putting x into the equation in different units from the data
description.zh: 代入方程的 x 和数据的单位不一致

description.en: Reading a strong relationship as proof of cause
description.zh: 把强的相关当作因果的证明

title.en: The line with the smallest mistakes

text.en: Armand’s Pizza Parlors near ten campuses: $x$ is the student population (thousands), $y$ the quarterly sales (\$ thousands). A line predicts sales from students; the gap between a point and the line is that restaurant’s **error**. Each error is drawn as a square: big errors cost a lot, because squaring punishes them. Drag the line’s two ends and make the **sum of the squares** (SSE) as small as you can.
text.zh: Armand’s Pizza 在十所大学附近的分店：$x$ 是学生人数（千人），$y$ 是季度销售额（千美元）。一条直线用学生人数预测销售额；一个点到直线的距离就是那家店的**误差**。每个误差画成一个正方形：大的误差代价很高，因为平方会惩罚它们。拖动直线的两端，让**平方和**（SSE）尽量小。

alt.en: Ten restaurants as points, a line you can bend, and the squared errors as squares.
alt.zh: 十家分店画成点，一条可以调整的直线，误差的平方画成正方形。

caption.en: Drag the two white ends up or down. Then press “Best line” to see what the least possible SSE is, and “Flat at the mean” for the baseline.
caption.zh: 上下拖动两个白色的端点。然后按“最佳直线”看最小可能的 SSE，按“水平的均值线”看基线。

prompt.en: The flat line at the mean of $y$ ignores the students completely. What are its SSE and its $r^2$?
prompt.zh: 在 $y$ 的均值处的水平线完全不管学生人数。它的 SSE 和 $r^2$ 是多少？

label.en: Its SSE equals SST (15,730), so $r^2 = 0$: it explains none of the variation.
label.zh: 它的 SSE 等于 SST（15,730），所以 $r^2 = 0$：它一点变化也没解释。

label.en: $r^2 = 1$: the mean is the best guess.

feedback.en: $r^2 = 1$ means no error at all. The flat line has the biggest error of any sensible line.
feedback.zh: $r^2 = 1$ 表示没有任何误差。水平线的误差在所有合理的直线里是最大的。

feedback.en: Press “Flat at the mean”: it is the baseline every regression has to beat.
feedback.zh: 按“水平的均值线”：它是每个回归都要打败的基线。

explain.en: SST is the squared error of the flat mean line; SSE is the squared error of your line; SSR = SST − SSE is how much your line improves on the mean. $r^2 = SSR/SST$.
explain.zh: SST 是水平均值线的平方误差；SSE 是你这条线的平方误差；SSR = SST − SSE 是你的线比均值线改进了多少。$r^2 = SSR/SST$。

text.en: **Meaning.** The slope is the change in $y$ for one more unit of $x$: here every extra thousand students goes with \$5 thousand more quarterly sales. The intercept is the predicted $y$ at $x = 0$ (here, a campus with no students: usually outside the data and not to be trusted). $r^2$ is the **share of the variation in $y$ that the line accounts for**: 90.3% here. It is **not** “90% of the predictions are right”. The sign of $r_{xy}$ is the sign of the slope, and $r_{xy}$ near $\pm 1$ is a strong straight-line relationship. Strong association is not proof of cause.
text.zh: **含义。** 斜率是 $x$ 多一个单位时 $y$ 的变化：这里每多一千名学生，季度销售额多 \$5 千。截距是 $x = 0$ 时 $y$ 的预测值（这里是没有学生的校园：通常在数据范围之外，不可信）。$r^2$ 是**直线能解释的 $y$ 的变化所占的份额**：这里是 90.3%。它**不是**“90% 的预测是对的”。$r_{xy}$ 的符号和斜率的符号相同，$r_{xy}$ 接近 $\pm 1$ 表示很强的直线关系。强相关不等于因果。

text.en: **By hand with a calculator** (the exam allows only a Casio fx-82): fill a small table of $x_i - \bar x$, $y_i - \bar y$ and their products and squares, as in the lecture; or use the calculator’s two-variable statistics mode, which gives $\bar x$, $\bar y$, $b_0$ and $b_1$ directly (check the mode on your own calculator before the exam). Either way write the sums on the paper: the marks are for the working.
text.zh: **用计算器手算**（考试只允许 Casio fx-82）：像课上那样列一张小表，算 $x_i - \bar x$、$y_i - \bar y$ 以及它们的乘积和平方；或者用计算器的双变量统计模式，它会直接给出 $\bar x$、$\bar y$、$b_0$ 和 $b_1$（考前在你自己的计算器上确认这个模式）。不管哪种，都要把各个和写在卷子上：分数是给过程的。

prompt.en: For ten sales vice presidents the least-squares line of bonus on salary (both in \$ thousands) has $b_1 = 1114/6046$ and $b_0 = \bar y - b_1 \bar x$, with $\bar x = 142$ and $\bar y = 16$. Predict the bonus (in \$ thousands, two decimals) for a salary of \$120 thousand.
prompt.zh: 十位销售副总裁的奖金对年薪（均以千美元计）的最小二乘直线中，$b_1 = 1114/6046$，$b_0 = \bar y - b_1 \bar x$，其中 $\bar x = 142$，$\bar y = 16$。预测年薪 \$120 千的人的奖金（千美元，两位小数）。

title.zh: 考试里的版本：袋鼠的鼻子

text.en: The second half of Question 5. Twelve male eastern grey kangaroos: can nasal length predict nasal width? Four parts, 12 marks. The lab has the data: bend the line, then press “Best line” to check what you computed.
text.zh: 第 5 题的下半。十二只雄性东部灰袋鼠：鼻子的长度能预测宽度吗？四问，12 分。实验区里有这些数据：调整直线，再按“最佳直线”核对你算出来的结果。

title.zh: 第 5 题，一元回归 · 12 分

paras.en: Eastern Grey Kangaroo is a marsupial mammal that belongs to a small group called macropods in Australia. For a quick research study, a scientist wanted to examine whether you could use nasal length (mm) to predict nasal width (mm) for male Eastern Grey Kangaroos. The table below shows a random group of 12 male Easter Grey Kangaroo’s nasal length and width.
paras.zh: 东部灰袋鼠是澳大利亚一个叫大袋鼠类的小类群里的有袋哺乳动物。为了做一个快速的研究，一位科学家想检验能否用鼻子长度（毫米）预测雄性东部灰袋鼠的鼻子宽度（毫米）。下表是随机抽取的 12 只雄性东部灰袋鼠的鼻子长度和宽度。

paras.en: (v) Develop an estimated regression equation that can be used to predict nasal width (mm) for male Eastern Grey Kangaroos given the nasal length (mm). [6 marks]
paras.zh: (v) 建立一个估计回归方程，用鼻子长度（毫米）预测雄性东部灰袋鼠的鼻子宽度（毫米）。[6 分]

paras.en: (vi) Using the regression equation found in part (v), interpret the slope coefficient. [2 marks]
paras.zh: (vi) 用 (v) 中得到的回归方程，解释斜率系数。[2 分]

paras.en: (vii) Using the regression equation found in part (v) to predict nasal width (mm) for male Eastern Grey Kangaroos given nasal length is 75 cm. [2 marks]
paras.zh: (vii) 用 (v) 中得到的回归方程，预测鼻子长度为 75 厘米的雄性东部灰袋鼠的鼻子宽度（毫米）。[2 分]

paras.en: (viii) Given that SSR = 5,629.74 and SSE = 1,492.26, compute the coefficient of determination r² and the sample correlation coefficient rxy. [2 marks]
paras.zh: (viii) 已知 SSR = 5,629.74，SSE = 1,492.26，计算决定系数 r² 和样本相关系数 rxy。[2 分]

alt.en: The twelve kangaroos: nasal width against nasal length, with a line you can bend.
alt.zh: 十二只袋鼠：鼻宽对鼻长，带一条可以调整的直线。

caption.en: Press “Best line”: its slope and intercept are what part (v) asks for.
caption.zh: 按“最佳直线”：它的斜率和截距就是 (v) 要的。

say.en: The two means: the sums of the lengths and widths divided by 12.
say.zh: 两个均值：长度和宽度各自的总和除以 12。

say.en: Fill the table (or the calculator’s statistics mode): the cross-products add to 18,909, the squared deviations of the lengths to 63,511.
say.zh: 填表（或用计算器的统计模式）：交叉乘积加起来是 18,909，长度的偏差平方加起来是 63,511。

say.en: The slope, from the formula sheet.
say.zh: 斜率，用公式表上的公式。

say.en: The intercept: $\bar y - b_1 \bar x$. Keep three or more decimals here: a rounded slope shifts the intercept.
say.zh: 截距：$\bar y - b_1 \bar x$。这里保留三位或更多小数：斜率取整会让截距偏掉。

say.en: The estimated regression equation: $x$ is the nasal length and $\hat y$ the predicted nasal width, both in mm.
say.zh: 估计回归方程：$x$ 是鼻长，$\hat y$ 是预测的鼻宽，单位都是毫米。

outro.zh: **答案：** $\hat y = 41.571 + 0.2977x$（宽度和长度单位都是毫米）。

say.en: (vi) Say it in words, with units: each extra millimetre of nasal length goes with 0.2977 mm more nasal width.
say.zh: (vi) 用文字加单位说出来：鼻子长度每多 1 毫米，鼻子宽度大约多 0.2977 毫米。

say.en: (vii) The trap: the equation is in mm, so convert first.
say.zh: (vii) 陷阱：方程用的是毫米，所以先换算。

say.en: The predicted nasal width: about 265 mm. (750 mm is inside the data’s range 606 to 820: a safe prediction.)
say.zh: 预测的鼻子宽度：约 265 毫米。（750 毫米在数据范围 606 到 820 之内：预测是可靠的。）

say.en: The share explained, and the correlation with the sign of the slope (positive).
say.zh: 被解释的份额，以及带斜率符号（正）的相关系数。

outro.en: **Answer:** (vi) about 0.30 mm of width per mm of length; (vii) about 265 mm; (viii) $r^2 = 0.79$, $r_{xy} = 0.89$: a strong positive relationship, with 79% of the variation in width accounted for by length.
outro.zh: **答案：** (vi) 每毫米长度对应约 0.30 毫米的宽度；(vii) 约 265 毫米；(viii) $r^2 = 0.79$，$r_{xy} = 0.89$：很强的正相关，长度解释了宽度变化的 79%。

prompt.en: A student puts $x = 75$ straight into $\hat y = 41.571 + 0.2977x$ and gets 63.9. What went wrong?
prompt.zh: 一位同学把 $x = 75$ 直接代入 $\hat y = 41.571 + 0.2977x$，得到 63.9。哪里错了？

label.en: The equation was fitted with lengths in mm; 75 cm is 750 mm. A width of 64 mm is also far outside the data (215 to 284).
label.zh: 方程是用毫米的长度拟合的；75 厘米是 750 毫米。64 毫米的宽度也远在数据范围（215 到 284）之外。

label.en: Nothing: the equation takes any unit.
label.zh: 没错：方程什么单位都行。

feedback.en: The slope has a unit: mm of width per mm of length.
feedback.zh: 斜率是带单位的：每毫米长度对应多少毫米宽度。

label.en: The intercept should have been subtracted.

feedback.en: The equation is $b_0 + b_1 x$ as written.
feedback.zh: 方程就是写成的 $b_0 + b_1 x$。

explain.en: Always convert to the units the equation was built in, and sanity-check the answer against the data.
explain.zh: 一定要换算成建方程时用的单位，并拿答案和数据比一比，看合不合理。

title.en: The full-mark answers, as they are written
title.zh: 满分答案，写在卷子上是这样
第 5 题 (v) 到 (viii)，满分写法

paras.en: (vi) For every 1 mm increase in nasal length of a male Eastern Grey Kangaroo, nasal width is expected to be 0.2977 mm greater.
paras.zh: (vi) 雄性东部灰袋鼠的鼻子长度每增加 1 毫米，预期鼻子宽度大 0.2977 毫米。

paras.en: (viii) SST = SSR + SSE = 7,122. r² = SSR/SST = 5,629.74/7,122 = 0.79. rxy = +√0.79 = 0.89: a strong positive relationship between nasal length and nasal width.
paras.zh: (viii) SST = SSR + SSE = 7,122。r² = SSR/SST = 5,629.74/7,122 = 0.79。rxy = +√0.79 = 0.89：鼻子长度和宽度之间有很强的正相关。

body.en: (v) is 6 marks: the means, the two sums, $b_1$, $b_0$, the equation, each written. (vi) needs the number with both units and the words “for every 1 mm increase”. (vii) needs the unit conversion. (viii) needs both $r^2$ and $r_{xy}$ with its sign.
body.zh: (v) 占 6 分：均值、两个和、$b_1$、$b_0$、方程，每一步都要写出来。(vi) 需要带两个单位的数以及“每增加 1 毫米”这样的话。(vii) 需要单位换算。(viii) 要同时写 $r^2$ 和带符号的 $r_{xy}$。

title.zh: r² 不是“正确的百分比”

body.en: $r^2 = 0.79$ means the line accounts for 79% of the *variation* in $y$ around its mean. The predictions are never exactly right.
body.zh: $r^2 = 0.79$ 的意思是这条线解释了 $y$ 围绕均值的*变化*的 79%。预测从来不是恰好正确的。

body.en: A strong line between nasal length and width says they move together, not that one makes the other.
body.zh: 鼻长和鼻宽之间的强直线关系说明它们同步变化，不说明谁导致了谁。

body.en: Predicting far outside the range of $x$ in the data (a campus of 200,000 students) is extrapolation: the straight line may simply stop being true.
body.zh: 在远超出数据里 $x$ 的范围处预测（一个有 20 万学生的校园）叫外推：这条直线很可能不再成立。

prompt.en: $z = -1.49$ is looked up in the paper’s table at:
prompt.zh: 在试卷的表里，$z = -1.49$ 要在这里查：

feedback.en: Rows hold units and tenths, columns the hundredths, with no rounding up.
feedback.zh: 行是个位和十分位，列是百分位，不进位。

explain.en: Row: units and tenths; column: hundredths.
explain.zh: 行：个位和十分位；列：百分位。

prompt.en: With $n = 3$ customers each buying with probability 0.3, the expected number of buyers is:
prompt.zh: 3 位顾客，每位以 0.3 的概率购买，购买人数的期望是：
